unavoidable_exposure.description: Connector returned only issues and included their current bodies. Full output was accidentally large and truncated. Release/recruitment checklists contain merged/fixed/checkmarked claims and references; these are exposure, not used as qualifying requests or proof of outcomes.

PR descriptions themselves contain claimed fixes, implementation summaries, compile results or performance numbers. Body reading required to assess author goal; no patch/comment/test endpoint opened. These claims are not reproduced as verified outcomes.
Unfiltered API JSON retains state/update/closed/pull_request metadata. Displayed direct-read extracts were author/date/title/body. No later PR discussion or merge-end conclusion was sought.

boundaries: Query results beyond fixed ten were retained as receipts but not directly recruited.
Official source code read solely at v3.0.1 pin, which predates auxiliary PR.
No claim of clean outcome blindness after current-body exposure.
